data.name: Wild Shape
data.description: A swamp druid gains this ability at 6th level, except that her effective druid level for the ability is equal to her druid level - 2.

raw_tokens.value: A swamp druid gains this ability at 6th level, except that her effective druid level for the ability is equal to her druid level - 2.

can assume the form of a Small or Medium ooze as if using beast shape III (treating the ooze as if it were a magical beast without a natural armor bonus).|PREABILITY:1,CATEGORY=Archetype,Druid Archetype ~ Cave Druid|PREVAREQ:WildShapeProgression,4
can assume the form of a Tiny or Large ooze as if using beast shape IV (treating the ooze as if it were a magical beast without a natural armor bonus).|PREVAREQ:WildShapeProgression,5

can assume the form of a Small or Medium vermin as if using beast shape IV (treating the vermin as an animal to determine its ability and natural armor modifiers).|PREABILITY:1,CATEGORY=Archetype,Druid Archetype ~ Desert Druid|PREVAREQ:WildShapeProgression,4

can assume the form of a Tiny or Large vermin as if using beast shape IV (treating the vermin as an animal to determine its ability and natural armor modifiers).|PREABILITY:1,CATEGORY=Archetype,Druid Archetype ~ Desert Druid|PREVAREQ:WildShapeProgression,5
can assume the form of a Large giant as if using giant form I.|PREABILITY:1,CATEGORY=Archetype,Druid Archetype ~ Mountain Druid|PREVAREQ:WildShapeProgression,5
can assume the form of a Huge giant as if using giant form II.|PREABILITY:1,CATEGORY=Archetype,Druid Archetype ~ Mountain Druid|PREVAREQ:WildShapeProgression,7
